video_title: Dillon Brooks talks Contract Extension & Staying in Phoenix Long Term

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on his long-term commitment to the Phoenix Suns
quotes.excerpt: I think BG, Josh planned out something that is going to be for the long term.
quotes.quote: I think BG, Josh planned out something that is going to be for the long term, and I want to be here for the long term. So, whatever it was, I was going to accept it and be a Phoenix Sun.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on the impact of new roster additions
quotes.excerpt: I think we added some shooting, some spacing with both of those guys and some athleticism.
quotes.quote: I think we added some shooting, some spacing with both of those guys and some athleticism. And then we can interchange lineups. Miles helps that, acquiring him, and we get a little more youthful. I am excited. I cannot wait to start.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on the trust from the Phoenix front office
quotes.excerpt: It makes you comfortable. It gives you a sense of trust.
quotes.quote: It makes you comfortable. It gives you a sense of trust. From the beginning, since the trade happened, I felt that trust, and that is why I played so hard. That is why it was easy to agree to this extension and be a part of a great organization.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on the team's commitment to constant improvement
quotes.excerpt: It is a good standard to live by. You somehow get better every week, every month.
quotes.quote: It is a good standard to live by. You somehow get better every week, every month. And you are around the same guys that you are going to be playing with, so you are creating that chemistry. That is just the way it is supposed to be. Guys working, guys getting better, so when we come back, we are sharpening each other's game and tools that we have. That makes a team uplifting, growing, and getting better for the next year.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on the defensive benefits of the new roster
quotes.excerpt: Guarding and being able to switch and having that trust will help that fix it up.
quotes.quote: Guarding and being able to switch and having that trust will help that fix it up. Having that shooting as well with Luke, and then he can play point. He is playing point a little bit in the playoffs too with the Lakers. So, that is going to help us a lot with going into the playoffs, going into the series.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on the departure of key veteran teammates
quotes.excerpt: We miss Grayson and we miss Royce. Those guys were the building stones of it.
quotes.quote: We miss Grayson and we miss Royce. Those guys were the building stones of it. We are going to miss that shooting, we are going to miss that veteran savvy. But we tell them good luck and the next part of their journey is in, and when we play up, when we play us, we hope they have their worst game.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on his professional goals and championship mindset
quotes.excerpt: My mind is just a championship, and how do we do it with the 17 guys.
quotes.quote: I just took it year by year. I had a goal in my head year by year. For me, it is just winning a championship. You do not get blessed to be on great, great teams or superstar players right off the bat. You have got to grind it out. So, on my mind is just a championship, and how do we do it with the 17 guys that we got.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on his connection with the Phoenix community
quotes.excerpt: The atmosphere that we have in our arena, the fans made it kind of easier to stay.
quotes.quote: The atmosphere that we have in our arena, the fans made it kind of easier to stay. Even though I feel like in each city I have been, I am a fan favorite or fans gravitate towards me, but here it just felt a lot different. It kind of brought me back to the Oregon days. The fans are amazing and I cannot wait for these four years to do a deep dive into the communities.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on playing against the 76ers on LeBron's birthday
quotes.excerpt: That is more ammunition for me to win that game.
quotes.quote: That is LeBron's birthday too? He did tell me that in one of the playoff series. I am excited. That is more ammunition for me to win that game. It should be fun.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on the importance of continuity for the team
quotes.excerpt: We do not have to change too much. Guys know exactly what they are going to bring.
quotes.quote: We do not have to change too much. Guys know exactly what they are going to bring. They have got to be better in their roles, and I feel like with having most guys back, that quick start that we had last year, we hope to have and work hard to get to that quick start this year.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on learning from his hand injury last season
quotes.excerpt: I got to be healthy in order for us to be really good, top of our game.
quotes.quote: It was frustrating because that was crunch time for us to make some leeway into not playing in the play-in. I was kind of grooving at those times too. It was a learning lesson, and I am taking that learning lesson into this season. I learned I got to be healthy in order for us to be really good, top of our game.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on his training relationship with Coach Pete
quotes.excerpt: You can see a little bit of your game in Coach Pete, just a lot of foundation level.
quotes.quote: You can see a little bit of your game in Coach Pete, just a lot of foundation level. I am glad that we drafted him because now he can get all the knowledge and the nooks and the crannies. Maybe not the crazy, but the knowledge of the game that I have, but just more athletic, and that is going to help him tremendously when he starts figuring out what his game is and when we start getting in the gym and working.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on his appreciation for the WNBA
quotes.excerpt: They opened me up to WNBA. The two cities that I was in never had a WNBA team.
quotes.quote: They opened me up to WNBA. The two cities that I was in never had a WNBA team. And the football does not match up right. I am a fan and I love watching the games. I love seeing the game at different lens, and the women's basketball game, they are a lot more skilled. You have got to be more skilled to be really good at the game in the WNBA. It is fun to watch girls do certain moves and how do they get to different shots.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on his offseason focus on shooting and passing
quotes.excerpt: I want to add a separation three shot to keep the defense honest.
quotes.quote: I want to add a separation three shot to keep the defense honest, kind of get a little higher and tighter on me so I can get to the paint and get to the shots that I really like. Passing, BG told me I got to work on passing, so I have been working on that and finishing, finishing around the rim.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on his motivation beyond the contract
quotes.excerpt: I am not content with just getting money and being rewarded like that.
quotes.quote: I am not content with just getting money and being rewarded like that. I love basketball, so you know, my reward would be a championship or something that is obviously, you know, 73 million is showcasing that you are a pretty good player, but you know, accolades from the NBA. Some like that. So that always keeps my engine going.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on his interest in the Hispanic community
quotes.excerpt: There was a big Hispanic community in Houston, which I got to see and got to experience.
quotes.quote: There was a big Hispanic community in Houston, which I got to see and got to experience. So, this year is that is on my list, for sure. But I got to know the places where they are so I can, you know, know exactly where I am, I want to say getting into, but not really getting into, how I can help.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on the moment he knew he wanted to stay in Phoenix
quotes.excerpt: I knew I want to be here for the long term.
quotes.quote: I would say it was probably around, but right before I got hurt with my hand. Like I knew I want to be here for the long term. Like I have got to experience the coaches, the players, the front office, Matt, and that is how I envisioned a team. So, I knew I never want -- I do not want to be anywhere else, and for me, it was easy.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on his defensive versatility and guarding multiple positions
quotes.excerpt: That is why I really got skinny so now I can play the three spot instead of four.
quotes.quote: That is why I really got skinny so now I can play the three spot instead of four. Now, Miles is going to be able to, you know, give us that, you know, that size, the agility, and the athleticism to guard the fours. So, it is going to be able to, you know, make me be able to guard some of the wings and, you know, the guards, which I like. I am a challenge to be able to guard guards and challenge them to be able to, you know, get out of his, you know, comfort zone to be able to, you know, make them better. So, you can guard any position, not only fours and threes, but, you know, guarding guys from Kawhi Leonard to De'Aaron Fox.
